Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1166
Claimant:
James Wise
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
1-23-25
Claim opened for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind at a traffic light. The
claimant reports a back strain and is represented by counsel, so all further contact will go thruogh the attorney's
office.
3-3-25
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
3-14-25
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer's notes
match the account given by the other driver.
3-30-25
Witness statements and scene photographs were received. Both witnesses describe the impact in the same
sequence the other driver described, and the photos show damage consistent with that account.
4-16-25
Inspected the vehicle damage. The location and severity of the crush line fit the reported impact, and no prior damage
to the vehicle is known from the claim history or the appraiser's notes.
5-22-25
Spoke with the claimant's counsel about the injury. The reported back strain fits the kind and force of a rear-end
impact, and the claimant has told the same account of the collision in every conversation so far.
6-3-25
Requested prior medical records from the claimant's providers. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from
the claimant's history or the records received to date.
6-15-25
Reviewed treatment records. The care followed a usual course of physical therapy and follow-up visits, and the
frequency of visits tapered as the claimant's reported symptoms improved.
7-17-25
Received the latest treatment update through counsel. The claimant is progressing, and the rmeaining care appears
to be consistent with the expected recovery timeline for this type of injury.
7-22-25
Reviewed the full file with the other evidence in hand. Liability, injury, and vehicle damage all line up with the reported
collision, and the claim is being prepared for evaluation on that basis.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
